text:
Priya: Heads-up 0: need a condensed micropilot plan for Adaptive Batching to present in roadmap review tomorrow. Key asks: recruitment criteria, three-week success metrics, must-have telemetry, minimum promised scope, and fallback/rollback plan. Target: 6-10 partners. Quick inputs so I can stitch into the slide deck.
Sam: Ops constraints first: batching semantics will be enabled in hosted and VPC modes, but not on air-gapped setups for this pilot. We need partner opt-in for batching (toggle) and a per-org max burst setting. Also require an expected peak-concurrent-requests number for capacity planning.
Avery: Feedback/QA: require each partner to deliver a 50-example canonical prompt set and a small labeled sample (10-20 labeled outputs) so we can run parity checks. We'll run nightly automated evals and surface weekly diffs. Add an "anomaly" alert if average latencies degrade >20% or if mean quality drops by >7%.
Luis: Recruitment criteria: prefer teams that have a measurable latency problem with current infra and a product owner committed to weekly check-ins. Incentives: $750 account credits + two 1-hour engineering office-hours sessions during the pilot + a post-pilot performance playbook tailored to their workload. Screen for legal readiness: ability to sign a one-page pilot addendum (simple NDA/POC clause). Avoid heavy regulatory customers for now.
Maya: Onboarding flow suggestion: 45-min kickoff, sample integration repo, test harness for synthetic load, and a checklist for telemetry keys we need (request_id, route_id, model_variant, token_count, duration_ms, error_code). Intake form snippet:```
- org_name
- contact_name/email
- product_owner
- primary_use_case (2 lines)
- current_p99_latency_ms
- expected_peak_concurrency
- average_prompt_length_tokens
- can_share_prompts (yes/no)
- legal_ready (yes/no)
- preferred_deployment (hosted/vpc)
- commit_weeks (3)
```
Priya: Good. Scope negotiation: promise batching control (on/off), model pinning for pilot, per-org token/burst budget, telemetry dashboard. Do NOT promise kernel-level tuning, custom quantization, or host-level HW changes. Also promise a safe rollback to previous non-batched behavior per-route.
Sam: We'll implement per-route rollback via config, and an automated health-check that runs every 5 minutes post-rollout. If errors or latency regressions exceed thresholds, route auto-reverts and we notify the partner + internal oncall.
Avery: Success metrics proposal specific to this pilot:
- Activation: at least 70% of partners enable batching and send traffic within the first 5 days
- Latency improvement: median latency reduction >=10% across active partners
- No severe regressions: <15% of partners experience >20% tail-latency increase
- Evaluation: at least 80% of partners can export eval results and review the weekly diff deck
Luis: Commercial signal: at least 30% of partners indicate willingness to move to Dedicated or request a roadmap commitment for broader batching support.
Maya: UX/Developer acceptance: partners should be able to run the sample harness and export raw telemetry within 72 hours of onboarding. We should also provide a quick-run script to generate a recommended batch window size based on prompt length distribution.
Priya: Action items (short):
- Sam: add intake field for expected_concurrency and implement auto-revert health check (ETA: EOD)
- Avery: create canonical prompt & labeled sample template + weekly diff deck template (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Luis: draft outreach email + pilot addendum + finalize incentive wording, send 6 high-fit targets (ETA: today EOD)
- Maya: publish onboarding checklist and sample harness repo, include telemetry key examples (ETA: tomorrow)
devrel-bot: forms-publish: adaptive-batching-pilot-intake v1 posted to /internal/pilot-forms (status: success)
Sam: minor: add "retention_days_for_logs" field to intake so SRE can estimate storage.
Priya: good point. Add that. Anything else? If no major objections I'll lock these assumptions and run outreach with Luis' copy. Thanks all. :clap:
